reading.body:
Liam Anderson is named on 5 AI lobbying filings, all filed through one firm, for a single client, and those filings name 15 separate bills.

The pattern is concentration on the client side and breadth on the bill side. One lobbyist, one firm, one client, THE AI POLICY NETWORK INC., but 15 distinct bills. That is the shape of a portfolio approach to legislation rather than a fight over one statute.

The disclosed prior government positions are the other half of the record. Communications director for two members of Congress, staff for a third, and staff at HHS. The Lobbying Disclosure Act requires filers to list covered positions held in the prior twenty years, so this is a disclosure requirement rather than an inference about influence.

What the data does not cover matters here. It does not say what the bills would do, whether any moved, what was spent, or what positions were advocated. It records that a name appears on filings, and nothing about the outcome of that appearance.

summary: Liam Anderson is named as a lobbyist on 5 Lobbying Disclosure Act filing(s) about AI held by this site. The firms, clients and AI bills on those filings are below. LDA lobbyist id 150951. A different lobbyist with the same name has a separate page.
